# The reference pYIN's reading of the pitch tracker's test scale, recorded so CI never runs pyin.
#
# Read by `our_track_agrees_with_pyin_on_a_scale` in crates/duet-capture/src/pitch.rs.
# Recorded with pyin 1.2.0 (crates.io, MIT): PYINExecutor::<f32>::new(fmin 60.0, fmax 1400.0,
# sr 22050, frame_length 1024, win_length Some(512), hop_length Some(256), resolution Some(0.1)),
# then .pyin(&signal, f32::NAN, Framing::Valid). The signal is that file's `tests::scale()`:
# 0.2 s of silence, then C4 D4 E4 F4 G4 (261.63, 293.66, 329.63, 349.23, 392.0 Hz), 0.25 s each,
# from synth::note_sequence(22050, .., 4 partials, 0.5), then 0.2 s of silence.
#
# One line per frame: frame index, f0 in Hz (`-` when pyin says unvoiced), voiced probability.
# Frame k starts k * 256 samples into the signal, as our frame k does.
#
# To re-record (only when the signal or the settings above change, never to make a failing
# comparison pass): add `pyin = "1.2.0"` under [dev-dependencies], paste the recorder in that
# test's doc comment into pitch.rs's tests, run
#   PYIN_OUT=crates/duet-capture/tests/fixtures/pyin-scale.body cargo test -p duet-capture --lib record_pyin_scale
# put this header above the body, then delete the recorder and the dependency again: pyin pulls
# in zip 0.5, which cargo audit refuses.
